title: Agricultural beneficial microbes accelerate soil degradation of poly(butylene adipate-co-terephthalate) (PBAT) films
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50481-50493
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06589E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuan He, Yun Huang, Yi Dan, Long Jiang, Hong Zhang, Huan Liu, Yanjiao Qi
The introduction of agricultural beneficial microbes into soil environments leads to over 70% mass loss after 360 days under specific dose conditions (Tri15). It is efficient and feasible to utilize agricultural beneficial microbes as a strategy of accelerating degradation of PBAT.
